answer: There is one honest road in, and it runs through Parchment maker kidskin mark stretched on the parchment loft: the toll is each kidskin is a stretching record witnessed by the master parchmenter, paid where everyone can watch. The panel trusts no applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open to everyone. Curing a proof takes 6 days, and a farm holding 853 proofs cannot cure them side by side. A sparrow can be painted, a jade can be borrowed, but a dawn must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. An honest proof ages like good varnish; a farm proof cracks before the epoch ends.
